name: Amakake Naho
source:
"We can only experience youth once in our lifetime, and it would be a waste to not fall in love when you're young!"

Love Committee's chairman and the most popular student in the school. She has had a strong interest for love ever since her childhood, and thus she established the Love Committee in order to encourage people falling in love.
